caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular mirror with a medium brown wooden frame. The mirror is mounted on a backing board that is rounded at the top, also in a brown color, and attached with a small metal chain or hook. The mirror is angled to the right, casting a faint shadow to the right side on the light beige background. Two small round fasteners are visible at the bottom corners of the frame. The surface of the mirror has a light blue tint with subtle shading, suggesting reflection. Centered below the mirror, the words "Mirror and Back" are neatly written in a thin, gray serif font.
title: Shaker Looking Glass and Rack
